LESSON: MAGNETISM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 4.2: Magnetism

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Magnetism. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Magnetism
2. Practise Magnetism at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Magnetism

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Magnetism
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Magnetism. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Magnetism at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Magnetism at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Magnetism
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Magnetism. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Magnetism using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Magnetism in the examples.
2. Explain Magnetism to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Magnetism.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Magnetism using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Magnetism important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Magnetism
2. Practise Magnetism at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Magnetism

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
